title: Phase 1: Brief and Templates
goal: Know the ask, the templates, and the brand rules.
unlocks: A brief the content record is built from.

title: Phase 2: Content Records
goal: One source of truth, fanned out to three renditions that cannot drift.

title: Phase 3: Approval Chain
goal: Three approvals of the current version, in order, or back to rework.
unlocks: A launch, or a new version.

title: Phase 4: Fan-out and Tracking
goal: Codes from the policy, send times from the schedule, a package per channel.

title: Phase 5: Rollup and Learning
goal: Join the week's numbers by code, name what did not join, keep the winners.
unlocks: The Friday rollup and next quarter's templates.
